name: Local Histogram Clustering for Volume Illumination
definition: A preprocessing technique to capture light interactions in volumes by computing local histograms for each voxel and clustering them into a smaller set of representative codebook entries to allow interactive rendering with minimal texture fetches.
summary: Local Histogram Clustering for Volume Illumination is a preprocessing technique that captures complex light interactions by clustering local histograms, enabling interactive rendering with minimal texture fetches and dynamic transfer function adaptation.
